“我还是太要脸了！”
凌晨三点，刘济民躺在床上像虫一样蠕动着身体。宿舍里，打鼾声和磨牙声此起彼伏，还能听到李卫国嘴里嘟囔着“罐焖牛肉”。
刘济民强迫自己闭上眼继续入睡，在舍友的呼噜声和膀胱的刺激下，他困倦的表情略显狰狞。无奈之下，只能披上衣服，晃晃悠悠走到厕所释放。
对于没有办法住在《解放军文艺》招待所，刘济民非常遗憾，早知道当初就故意出点纰漏。这样既可以成功住下，还能让编辑获得巨大的职业成就感，满足一下好为人师的心理。
家里和宿舍都太过拥挤，居住还可以，写稿子就略显嘈杂。
《解放军文艺》编辑部刚好就在地安门大街上，距离学校相对较近.....一想到这里，刘济民就懊恼，果然人还是不能太有良心。
刘济民抖了抖手，打了一个冷颤，转身趿拉着拖鞋回到了宿舍。
接下来的日子里，刘济民的生活大大改观，无产阶级套餐直接升级成红烧肉、红烧排骨之类的硬菜，餐盒得洗好几遍才能把里面的油洗净。
四月一号，是《解放军文艺》发表的日子。刚跑完操，顾不上吃饭，几人就拉着刘济民朝着王府井新华书店跑。
刘济民告诉他们，自己的稿子投的晚，这一期肯定没有。几人不相信，非要拉着刘济民过去看看。
到了王府井，新华书店还没有开门，不过门口却排起了长队，一打听才听说今天有《红楼梦》卖，大家都过来排队买《红楼梦》。
于是他们先到旁边的早餐店各买了份早餐。油条三分钱一根，两根油条六分钱，再来一碗小米粥两分钱，想吃饱点再来个肉包子，一毛钱基本上能吃饱了。
王府井的新华书店八点开门，几人吃完早餐，就直奔新华书店去了。
“春燕同志不是在吗？咱们直接从后面找到春燕同志，省得排队！”梁满囤提议道，顿了顿：“这不算耍特权吧？”
刘济民哼哼道：“这要是算的话，李春燕偷偷给你的中医书，算是以权谋私。”
李卫国笑着拍了拍梁满囤的肩膀：“满囤，没想到你看着老实巴交，竟然沾公家便宜。”
梁满囤顿时大囧，杨波出来打圆场：“好了好了，满囤是个厚道人，卫国你就别寻他开心了。满囤这是废物利用，学好医术，那是回去服务人民的。”
“就是！”梁满囤带头朝着新华书店的后门走去。

"I'm still too shameless!"
At three o'clock in the morning, Liu Jimin was lying on the bed, squirming like a worm. In the dormitory, snoring and teeth grinding could be heard one after another, and Li Weiguo could also be heard muttering "stewed beef in a pot."
Liu Jimin forced himself to close his eyes and continue to fall asleep. Under the stimulation of his roommate's snoring and bladder, his sleepy expression looked slightly ferocious. In desperation, I could only put on my clothes and wander to the toilet to release myself.
Liu Jimin was very sorry that he could not live in the "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" guest house. He had known that he had made some mistakes on purpose. In this way, you can not only successfully settle in, but also give the editor a huge sense of professional accomplishment and satisfy his desire to be a teacher.
My home and dormitory are both too crowded. Living is fine, but writing is a bit noisy.
The editorial office of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" happens to be on Di'anmen Street, relatively close to the school... When he thought of this, Liu Jimin was annoyed. Sure enough, people still can't be too conscientious.
Liu Jimin shook his hands, shuddered, turned around and pulled on his slippers and returned to the dormitory.
In the days that followed, Liu Jimin's life changed greatly. The proletarian set meal was directly upgraded to hard dishes such as braised pork and braised pork ribs. The lunch box had to be washed several times to remove the oil inside.
April 1st is the day when "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" is published. Just after they finished their exercise and without even bothering to eat, a few people pulled Liu Jimin and ran towards Wangfujing Xinhua Bookstore.
Liu Jimin told them that his manuscript was submitted late and it would definitely not be included in this issue. Several people didn't believe it and insisted on dragging Liu Jimin over to have a look.
When we arrived at Wangfujing, Xinhua Bookstore was not open yet, but there was a long queue at the door. After asking, I heard that "Dream of Red Mansions" was on sale today. Everyone came and lined up to buy "Dream of Red Mansions".
So they first went to the breakfast shop next door and each bought a breakfast. A fried dough stick costs three cents, two fried dough sticks cost six cents, and a bowl of millet porridge costs two cents. If you want to feel full, you can have a meat bun, which is basically enough for a dime.
Xinhua Bookstore in Wangfujing opened at eight o'clock. After a few people finished breakfast, they went straight to Xinhua Bookstore.
"Isn't Comrade Chunyan here? Let's find Comrade Chunyan directly from the back, so as not to queue up!" Liang Mandun suggested, then paused: "Isn't this considered a privilege?"
Liu Jimin hummed and said, "If this counts, the Chinese medicine book that Li Chunyan secretly gave you is an act of using power for personal gain."
Li Weiguo smiled and patted Liang Mandun on the shoulder: "Mandun, I didn't expect that you would take advantage of the public family when you look so honest."
Liang Mantun was immediately embarrassed, and Yang Bo came out to smooth things over: "Okay, okay, Mantun is a kind man, Weiguo, you can't make him happy. Mantun is using waste, learn medical skills, and then go back to serve the people."
"That's it!" Liang Manyun took the lead and walked towards the back door of Xinhua Bookstore.
